title: Bar chart
description: Several things measured in the same unit at the same moment: who is bigger, who rose, who fell.

unit.description: What the values measure: "% change", "million riders".

bars.description: Sorted so the order means something (largest first, or most negative to most positive). Never alphabetical.

value.description: The number from the article, as a plain number: 3.2 for "3.2 million", -1.5 for "down 1.5%".

display.description: Optional text shown instead of the bare number, as the article writes it: "-1.5%", "$3.2M".

note.description: Optional caveat or time frame: "First quarter, compared with a year earlier".
